description: STARS provides thermal and chemical reservoir simulation. Computer Modelling Group describes steam recovery, wellbore heat transfer, geomechanical effects and geothermal applications, including enhanced and closed-loop systems. The provider is Computer Modelling Group. Coverage: Coverage follows the network or reservoir supplied by the user. Spatial detail and the simulated time horizon are model settings; there is no fixed observation period. Access: The provider page describes the software and supplies a contact route for access. No executable or example model was obtained. Licence and cost: This is commercial software. The page does not establish the applicable licence agreement or a complete price; access terms must be confirmed with the provider. Limitations: Published capabilities are provider claims. No model was run and numerical accuracy was not independently tested. For infrastructure simulation it supports comparing extraction, injection and field-development scenarios using a project-specific reservoir model. Related resources: For comparison, model-geophires-x supplies geothermal project calculations. This catalogue relation does not imply interchangeable physical models.
